description: Second labelled retrieval set for 'Attention Is All You Need', written to be harder and less lexically leaky than the first: paraphrased questions share few words with the evidence; exact-number, entity, flattened-table, very short and cross-page questions are included. A chunk is relevant if it contains an evidence phrase (whitespace-normalised, case-insensitive); for `mode: all` (cross-page) every phrase must be covered by the top-k together. Limitations: one document, one author (who also knew the text), 38 questions; BM25 still benefits wherever the numbers or names are literal.
